turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi. I’ve been feeling lightheaded like I might faint, with really bad fatigue. I also have sensitive pain on the top of my head—forehead and left temple pain—and I’ve noticed black stools and also some bloody stool. I’m also much paler than usual.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. **One question at a time:**  

**1) When did the black stools and/or bloody stool start, and have they been happening repeatedly or just once?**
They started recently, and I’ve noticed them more than once—so it’s been happening repeatedly rather than only one time.
**2) Are you having any vomiting—especially vomiting blood or “coffee-ground” material?**
No, I’m not vomiting, and I don’t have any vomiting blood or coffee-ground stuff.
**3) Do you have any chest pain, shortness of breath, or a racing/irregular heartbeat?**
I don’t have chest pain or shortness of breath. I’m not sure about my heartbeat being racing or irregular, but I mostly feel lightheaded and very tired.
**4) Have you ever had a similar episode before, or any known history of ulcers/GERD, liver disease, or taking NSAIDs (ibuprofen/naproxen) or aspirin?**
I’ve had anemia before, but I don’t know of ulcers or GERD or liver disease. I don’t remember taking NSAIDs or aspirin recently.
**5) Are you currently taking any blood thinners (warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban, clopidogrel) or steroids?**
Yes—I’m taking an oral anticoagulant (a blood thinner). I’m not sure of the exact name, but I am on one. I’m not on steroids.
**6) Do you know if your anticoagulant is for atrial fibrillation or a prior clot (like DVT/PE), and approximately when you started it?**
I don’t know if it’s for atrial fibrillation. I think it was started because of a prior clot, but I’m not sure. I started it earlier than this episode, but I can’t give an exact date.
**7) Any recent fever, cough, or symptoms of infection (sore throat, runny nose, urinary symptoms)?**
No recent fever or cough. I also don’t have sore throat or runny nose. I don’t have urinary symptoms that I can tell.
**8) Have you noticed any severe headache features—sudden “worst headache,” neck stiffness, new neurologic symptoms (weakness, numbness, trouble speaking), or vision changes?**
I have headache pain on the top of my head, forehead, and left temple, and it feels sensitive, but I don’t have neck stiffness. I don’t have weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, or vision changes.
**9) Is the headache new for you, and how severe is it (0–10)?**
Yes, it feels new for me. The pain is about 5 out of 10.
**10) Any abdominal pain, heartburn, or pain with eating?**
I don’t have abdominal pain or heartburn, and I’m not sure about pain with eating—I haven’t noticed that.
**11) Are you having dizziness when standing up, and do you feel like you might actually pass out?**
Yes—when I stand up I get really lightheaded, like I might pass out.
**12) Have you had any recent weight loss, night sweats, or persistent diarrhea/constipation?**
I haven’t noticed weight loss or night sweats. I’m not sure about diarrhea or constipation.
**13) Any history of inflammatory bowel disease, colon polyps/cancer, or recent changes in bowel habits (besides the black/bloody stool)?**
No history of inflammatory bowel disease or colon polyps/cancer. Besides the black and bloody stools, I haven’t noticed major changes in bowel habits.
**14) Do you have any shortness of breath on exertion, or do you feel your heart is beating fast when you stand up?**
I don’t have shortness of breath on exertion. I do feel lightheaded when I stand, but I can’t say for sure if my heart is racing.
[DDX] Possible NSTEMI / STEMI, Pulmonary embolism, Anaphylaxis, Atrial fibrillation, Acute pulmonary edema
